notes: Core Y1 tag; most widely used standard tag for next-12-month maturities
Standard Y2 tag; reported in same footnote as Y1
Catch-all for >5yr maturities; critical for reading bond stacks in low-rate era issuance
Used in 10-Q filings for current fiscal year remainder; maps to Y1 proxy in annual context
Rolling 12-month variant; post-ASU-2016-13 some filers adopted this form
Rolling Y2 variant; parallel to InYearTwo but rolling vs calendar
Date field not amount; used to identify maturity date of a specific instrument rather than maturity schedule
Face value of specific instrument; requires pairing with DebtInstrumentMaturityDate
Balance-sheet total long-term debt; used as denominator in coverage validation
Noncurrent portion only; sometimes used instead of LongTermDebt
Current portion of long-term debt; maps to near-term maturity proxy
Revolving credit and CP; may overlap with LongTermDebtCurrent — requires dedup
Subset of LongTermDebt for unsecured bonds; do not double-count with LongTermDebt
Subset of LongTermDebt for secured loans
Senior notes line item; may duplicate LongTermDebt depending on footnote structure
Combined total; use only when LongTermDebt not available
Finance lease — looks like debt maturity tag but represents lease obligations NOT bond debt; EXCLUDE
Operating lease — EXCLUDE; frequently confused with debt maturity in automated parsing
Supply/purchase commitments — NOT debt maturities; EXCLUDE
Aggregated contractual obligation — contains lease and other non-debt items; EXCLUDE
HCA extension tag pre-2018; equivalent to standard Y1; discovered in 2017 10-K XBRL
HCA extension Y5+; used until 2018 then migrated to standard tags
Chesapeake Energy extension; gas producer with bespoke XBRL taxonomy 2014-2018
Disney extension pre-Fox acquisition integration; standardised post-2020
CenturyLink/Lumen extension; telco sector uses non-standard naming conventions
Ford Motor extension; automotive finance entities add complexity
GE Capital legacy extension; discontinued post-GE Capital wind-down (2019+)
Quarterly variant; used in 10-Q filings when issuer breaks out sub-annual schedule
Medical Properties Trust REIT extension; mortgage-level maturity vs corporate bond
CBL Associates aggregated Y1-Y5; requires manual allocation — flag as PARTIAL
Carrying value net of unamortised discount/premium; slightly < face for discount bonds
Notes payable line; may or may not include current portion depending on filer
Senior notes total; subset of LongTermDebt for senior-priority bonds
Hybrid capital instruments; lower in capital structure; usually small
Term loan aggregate; leveraged loan issuers often report separately from bonds
